# embtrace-sbom 0.10.0 — .NET / NuGet

- **NuGet is read.** `packages.lock.json` is the resolved truth: every
  package of every target framework with its resolved version, the SHA-512
  content hash of the .nupkg and its dependency edges; `type: Project`
  entries (project references inside the solution) are internal and never a
  component. `*.csproj`, `*.fsproj`, `*.vbproj` and `Directory.Build.props`
  contribute `<PackageReference>` entries as declared floors (a bare version
  is a floor in NuGet, `[x]` is exact, `[x, y)` keeps the floor `x`; Central
  Package Management via `Directory.Packages.props` and `VersionOverride`
  are resolved). A floating `1.0.*`, an exclusive lower bound or an MSBuild
  property `$(…)` stays unresolved — never an invented version. The classic
  `packages.config` is read as the installed set; `developmentDependency`
  entries are marked excluded. Where a lockfile exists, its resolved
  versions win over the project file's floors.
- Ecosystem `nuget`; package ids are case-insensitive.
- Measured on two public projects that commit lockfiles
  (siemens/opc-ua-pubsub-dotnet, nanoframework/nanoFramework.IoT.Device):
  52 and 142 components. Both are rows of the suite's nightly basket.
